ddr_service_model.arbitration: four-slot cycle: three weight-priority, one data-priority; work conserving; data R before W
ddr_service_model.limits: One 64 B service budget per DDR channel; data DMA and weight read share it
ddr_service_model.omitted: MIG/SmartConnect timing, DRAM banks and refresh; no host XDMA timing

group_boundaries.AttentionCore: first valid KV read-address offer on 256-bit core-domain data AXI0 to last PV context accepted
group_boundaries.GateUp: GateUp command launch to last SiLU-times-Up product accepted
group_boundaries.K: first actual K dispatch to last K quantized KV accepted
group_boundaries.O: first actual O dispatch to last O scaled linear output accepted
group_boundaries.Q: first actual Q dispatch to last Q RoPE accepted
group_boundaries.V: first actual V dispatch to last V quantized KV accepted

key_count_source: QK and Softmax totals derive from observed terminal key indices per row; PV value-input totals are structural inference from observed PV context output tiles times verified KV length, with no per-key PV input handshake probe, for both KV32 and KV128
limitations: The DDR service model omits actual MIG, SmartConnect, DRAM bank/refresh and host XDMA timing.
Independent complete-model numerical oracle is not established.
Strict active-power mean, energy and J/token are not established.
Unmeasured layers stay null; no 32-layer extrapolation or board-ratio correction.
service_window: first external weight address offer to same group's postprocessed end
